title: Norpro Omelet pan
text: Norpro Omelet pan. Did not seem to be a well built product. found screw and attached handle. it did make an omelet but was not impressed with ease of handling and turning over.

product_metadata.title: 9.2 inches Black Nonstick Omelet Pan
features: Measures: 6.5" x 9.25" x 2.5"/16.5cm x 23.5cm x 6cm Now you can make the perfect omelet, filled with all your favorite ingredients, quickly and easily.
The pan does the flipping for you, Simply flip the pan and your omelet is folded! Prepare two foods at once, Cook separately; eggs, hash browns, sausage, bacon or your favorite vegetables.

Also great for cooking small portions; use one side for cooking, flip the other side closed for a perfectly fit lid. Nonstick coating for easy release and cleaning. Stay cool handle. Easy to use and clean, Hand washing recommended.
